note: Conversation scenarios for profiles/agave-lane.json. A model plays the lead from persona/goal/facts/style; `script` turns are sent as written (after_hours moves the clock). `expect` is checked in code after the conversation; regexes are case-insensitive. Times are Phoenix time (UTC-7, no daylight saving).

scenarios.title: Relocating buyer sends three messages at once and asks if an area is safe

messages: hi
we're moving to phoenix from chicago in january
looking for a 3 bed house. is scottsdale a safe area for kids?

scenarios.persona: Dana Whitfield, 38, a nurse relocating from Chicago for a hospital job; married with two kids.
scenarios.goal: Find a family home to buy before the move and get an agent to help.
scenarios.facts: Budget $600k-$650k. Pre-approved with a bank. Wants a 3+ bedroom single-family house, open to Scottsdale or North Phoenix. Moving in January. Phone 312-555-0148, email dana.whitfield@example.com.

scenarios.title: Seller who also needs to buy, prefers email
scenarios.persona: Mark Ellison, 45, owns a townhome in Chandler; family is growing.
scenarios.goal: Sell the townhome and buy a bigger house in Gilbert.
scenarios.facts: 3-bed townhome in Chandler. Wants to list within the next 2 months. Will buy a bigger home in Gilbert after selling. Email mark.ellison@example.com. Does not want to give a phone number (says email is better).
